verdict.editorButtons: AGREES — Cancel and Update on both sides.
verdict.escape: AGREES, and this is the stronger result. meologue's Escape-scope fix used a window-level capture listener to stop the keydown reaching Radix's dismissable layer, which was reasoned from first principles as the right behaviour. Driving Todoist now shows Todoist does the same thing: Escape closes only the comment editor and leaves the detail dialog open. So the fix aligned meologue with Todoist, not merely with good sense.
verdict.menuShape: DIVERGES by shape, as already recorded — Todoist reaches editing through a comment options menu (Edit / Copy text / Copy link to comment / Delete); meologue uses a hover pencil and trash pair. The two jobs that apply are present on both sides.
verdict.deleteConfirmation: Unchanged from flow 5 and not re-read this flow: identical wording, differing only in role (dialog in Todoist, alertdialog in meologue), which stays on the accessibility-surplus list.
